descriptionHtml:
Approach · TC-09 All Residents Attendance Toggle (Nursing Home only) · S05 Existing spec: known / new / doubtful rows, the summary line and the duplicate review sheet

UAT steps / ticket ACs covered:

  • U3 The photo uses the same deduplication against All Residents as TC-02. Before anything is written, the physician sees how many residents are already known and how many are new (e.g. … (UAT TC-09; UAT TC-02 (by reference); TFA-92587 AC 3)

Test design technique: Decision table (decision-table) — List the combinations of several conditions and check each one, to see that the result follows the rule.

Given A linked resident not In Today, a resident In Today, and a mocked photo read with an existing row, a new row and a row whose MRN matches but whose name conflicts

When Scan, read the summary, add, and settle the doubtful row as the same resident

Then Rows are classed known / new / review with the summary line, and the doubtful row goes to the 'Possible duplicate residents' sheet. After it is settled as the same resident, the known resident is linked, not duplicated, and the new one is created. All Residents keeps everyone

Pass rule (oracle, excerpt): Playwright assertions in patient-list-capture.spec.ts (summary '1 already in All Residents · 1 new · 1 to review', 'Possible duplicate residents' dialog, All Residents). The test asserts nothing while the dialog is open, so it is not evidence that nothing is written before the decision (that is S18). …

Where it ran: local lane A (existing Playwright tests); test method PW · Playwright script; lane planned in the matrix: existing tests (Tim's Playwright) (automated)

S05 is our own case number (its number in the coverage matrix cases/TC-09.matrix.json), not a step number of the UAT document.

Environment: local — main e02167f → 43c38a4f (10-15 re-tests), local stack (not a deployed build); run folder runs/2026-10-14-local, lane A.

Test method: PW · Playwright script; secondary: AGENT · Browser agent — as classified in cases/test-methods.json, which says it runs on local; Source: matrix (lane A).
